Field notes · October

Autumn at the footbridge

What we found at the footbridge, and what to do before winter.

RFRed Fox9m ago

Lead with the recommendation; the finding can follow.

The river

The river , and both times the footbridge held. The second rise came within a hand of the deck boards, which is closer than any year since the bridge was rebuilt.

MLMaya Lindqvist3m ago

Was it twice? The log says once, on the 14th.

We recommend raising the deck by one course before the spring melt. The cost is modest and the work can be done in two days with the water low.

MLMaya Lindqvist5m ago

Two days is optimistic. Last time the same job took a week; say so, or give a range.

  • OTOtter2m ago

    Agreed. A range it is.

The path

RFRed Foxjust now

Walkers need a sign here before the meadow is gone.

The path on the north bank is washed out for about twenty metres. Walkers are cutting across the meadow, which is doing more harm than the river did.

Three reviewers sent their copies back; Tom opened his page with all of them loaded. He wants to read them in place before handing them on.

Content
  • The report with four threads from three people: Maya Lindqvist on the second paragraph and on "rose twice that week", Red Fox on the lede and on the pin under The path, Otter with a reply under Maya's second-paragraph thread.
  • Each card signed with its writer's avatar and name; the tag reads 4.
  • Comment mode off: Tom is reading.
Components
Comment card openAvatar smButton primary, quietComment control cornerHighlightIcon button quietPinText field
States
  • EmptyNot applicable

Interactions
  • Cards open and close, and Resolve, React and More work as for a reviewer; Edit and Delete show only on Tom's own comments.

Requirements

Hand the comments to an agent

Open in prototypeauthor.html#hand-to-agent

Give Tom one copy of every reviewer's comments, signed and placed, and the one prompt that tells his agent what to do with it.

Persona at this step
TATom Adeyemi

Tom has read them. He wants to paste them into his agent and get on.

Content
  • The page with the four threads at rest and the menu open with Copy comments unfolded (default).
  • After As Markdown (success): "Copied 4 comments as Markdown." beside the tag, and in the first paragraph's column a prompt card in the ring form, "Ask your agent", whose Copy prompt copies the instruction with the Markdown beneath it: the page title and address, the count, and every thread with its place, its writer and time, its words and its replies.
Wording
  • Copied {n} comments as Markdown. after As Markdown.
  • {writer}, {time}: {words} each comment and reply in the Markdown, so the agent knows who said it.
Components
Comment cardPopover menu splitPrompt card ringAvatar smButton join-end, join-start, quiet, ringed, secondaryCode block compact, flushComment control cornerHighlightIcon button quietInline alert successKeyPin
States
  • EmptyWith no open threads, "No open comments to copy." and no prompt card.
  • LoadingNot applicable
  • ErrorWhen the clipboard is blocked, the text is selected in place, as on a reviewer's page (clipboard-blocked).
Interactions
  • As Markdown copies as on a reviewer's page; the writer of every comment and reply is named, and resolved threads are left out.
  • The ring prompt's Copy prompt copies "Work through each thread below and say what changed." followed by the same Markdown, so one paste gives the agent both.
Requirements
  • FR-021 The copied Markdown names the writer and time of every comment and reply, and the author's page offers one prompt that carries it to a coding agent.
Acceptance criteria
  1. AC-hand-to-agent-1FR-021PassedGiven four threads by three writers, when Tom copies as Markdown, then the clipboard names Maya Lindqvist, Red Fox and Otter on their comments and the message reads "Copied 4 comments as Markdown."
  2. AC-hand-to-agent-2FR-021PassedGiven the prompt card, when he presses Copy prompt, then the clipboard holds "Work through each thread below and say what changed." followed by the Markdown.
Prompt for this screen

This journey

Collect feedback from several reviewers

Tom opens his page with three reviewers' threads on it, copies every comment as Markdown that says who wrote what and where, and hands it to his coding agent.

Goal
Tom gathers every reviewer's comments, pinned to their places and signed, in one text his agent can act on.
Trigger
Three to five reviewers have commented on the page he sent, some at the same time, and the deadline is tomorrow.
Outcome
His agent has one Markdown text with every open thread, its place and its writer, and he knows what changed.
Success
The copied Markdown names the writer of every comment and reply, so an agent never guesses (SC-002). Nothing a reviewer wrote is left out unless it was resolved.
Persona
TATom Adeyemi

  2. Hand the comments to an agent
